content.text: {"evidence":[{"note":"Directly reduces communication by skipping ineffective updates and error-feedback sparse exchange.","paper":"P5"},{"note":"Explicitly cuts split-learning communication by removing backward gradient exchange between client and server.","paper":"P47"},{"note":"Federated critic exchange is communication-efficient, but focuses on RAN control, not error propagation avoidance.","paper":"P11"},{"note":"Shares KV caches across heterogeneous LLMs; reduces repeated prefill, but not error signal propagation.","paper":"P18"},{"note":"Layer-wise exchange shares representations and adjoints across clients; close to reducing data exchange in GNNs.","paper":"P24"},{"note":"Communication-efficient distributed RL with weight synchronization sparsification and error feedback, somewhat related.","paper":"P5"},{"note":"Federated compression with adaptive sparsification and error feedback reduces exchanged bytes, but broader FL setting.","paper":"P41"},{"note":"DReLU sharing across channels/layers reduces nonlinear computations, not data exchange or error propagation.","paper":"P12"},{"note":"Local proxy networks reduce backprop memory and approximate gradients, but not shared-architecture communication.","paper":"P36"},{"note":"Optical in-network computing removes server communication overhead in distributed learning, but not error-signal propagation specifically.","paper":"P2"}],"ranking":["P5","P47","P11","P18","P24","P41","P36","P12","P2","P14","P19","P33","P26","P30","P21","P48","P44","P17","P23","P7","P35","P39","P38","P14","P41","P29","P4","P31","P49","P13","P22","P8","P9","P6","P34","P10","P27","P46","P42","P32","P37","P45","P25","P40","P20","P3","P15","P16","P28","P50"]}
